title: Aquarelle Rivière Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
One fine line, in two colours. A fine tennis bracelet of small round brilliant cut cubic zirconia of about 3mm, each stone in its own gold four claw cup and linked straight into the next, closed with a slim fold over clasp. In bright Royal Blue or soft Lavender. Fine enough for every day, and easy to stack two together.

STYLING TIP: Wear Royal Blue and Lavender together on one wrist.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Round brilliant cut cubic zirconia, approximately 3mm each
  • Colours: Royal Blue or Lavender
  • Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
